name: Kendrapara

queries.query: Kendrapara Odisha official cadastral parcel map land records GIS
queries.result: First-party results identified Odisha Bhulekh, the official BhuNaksha parcel-map viewer, the Odisha Revenue and Disaster Management Bhulekh page, ORSAC Odisha 4K GEO cadastral portal, and the official Kendrapara district Tahasil and Revenue pages. The district pages evidence Kendrapara Tahasil and revenue administration but do not publish an open parcel API.

Official Odia results identified the Odia Kendrapara Tahasil list and the Odisha Bhulekh/BhuNaksha public map and land-record services. No public Kendrapara parcel geometry response was found in the anonymous bounded checks.
